basis: No official attendance. Capacity 1,500 (official); open ~34 hours per weekend (Fri 22:00-Sat 10:00, Sat 23:59-Mon 10:00); average stay ~11 hours -> at most ~4,600 admissions per weekend at full turnover, ~240,000 a year (high). FAZEmag's explicitly hypothetical extrapolation: 2,000-4,500 people try to enter per weekend, two in three turned away -> ~56,000 admitted a year (low). Central = geometric mean, ~115,000 a year (~2,200 admissions per weekend). The pageview conversion gave ~5.9 million, 25-100x the capacity bound.
